cards.q: In an SCD Type 2 MERGE, why are changed rows staged a second time with a NULL merge key?
cards.a: Matched rows never reach WHEN NOT MATCHED, so the first copy can only close the old row. The NULL-key copy can never match, so it falls through to INSERT and creates the new current version.

cards.q: Why does t.address <> s.address miss some changes, and what do you use instead?
cards.a: Comparing anything to NULL with <> returns NULL, not true, so changes to or from NULL are skipped. Use IS DISTINCT FROM, or NOT (a <=> b).

cards.q: What happens if the MERGE source has two rows for the same key, and how do you fix it?
cards.a: The MERGE fails because multiple source rows match one target row. Keep only the latest row per key with row_number() before merging, or use Auto CDC with SEQUENCE BY.
